blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—A low-pressure area (LPA) being monitored outside the Philippine area of responsibility (PAR) could develop into a tropical depression by Tuesday or Wednesday and may enter the country’s monitoring zone by Thursday or Friday, the state weather bureau said Monday.
